experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.subtitle: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
experimental.warningTitle: Experimental features may break at any time.
experimental.warningDesc: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.

experimental.developerDesc: Internal tools for developing, testing, and debugging Paperclip.

agentChat.title: Agent Chat
agentChat.description: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution. Chat leads the Work group and opens an agent rail beside the nav, and each chat's side panel shows the agent's tasks and artifacts as cards.
agentChat.footnote: Turning this off preserves conversations and lets active runs finish, but prevents new messages.

artifactsV1.title: Artifacts V1
artifactsV1.description: Show artifacts the way the artifact directions lab settled: paper stacks and tiles on the Artifacts page, compact rows in the panel's Artifacts tab, and grouped rows in the task thread.
artifactsV1.footnote: Presentation only. Turning this off restores the current cards; no data changes.

assistantConnections.title: Assistant connections (MCP)
assistantConnections.description: Connect Codex, Claude, and other assistants to your Paperclip organization. People sign in, select an organization once, and approve access to review work, delegate tasks, and add feedback.
assistantConnections.footnote: Requires an authenticated instance with a configured public URL. Takes effect immediately. Turning this off blocks assistant calls and event delivery; work already delegated continues.

betaSkills.title: Beta skills
betaSkills.description: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.

builtInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
builtInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
cases.footnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.

chatConnectors.title: Chat connectors
chatConnectors.description: Connect agents to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
chatConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides experimental chat setup and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. AgentMail, GitHub review bots, and tool connectors are controlled separately.

combinedInboxTasks.title: Combined Inbox + Task List
combinedInboxTasks.description: Fold Inbox into Tasks. One Tasks row carries the unread badge, and a Views menu reaches every inbox view (Mine, Unread, Blocked, Recent, Everything) and every task view.
combinedInboxTasks.footnote: Old Inbox links redirect to the matching view. Turning this off restores the separate Inbox; no data changes.
combinedInboxTasks.aria: Toggle combined inbox and task list experimental setting

conferenceRoomChat.title: Conference Room Chat
conferenceRoomChat.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
conferenceRoomChat.aria: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.

environments.title: Enable Environments
environments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

externalObjects.title: Enable External Objects
externalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

isolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
isolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

fastResponses.title: Experimental fast responses
fastResponses.description: Allow short acknowledgements while agents begin work. Configure them in Settings → Connections.

fileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
fileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

firstTaskPlanProposal.title: First task: propose with a plan document
firstTaskPlanProposal.description: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
firstTaskPlanProposal.aria: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting

githubReviewBots.title: GitHub review bots
githubReviewBots.description: Connect agents to GitHub with their own App identity to review pull requests and respond to issues.
githubReviewBots.footnote: Independent of Chat connectors. Turning this off hides setup and management; existing bots keep running. GitHub tool connections stay available.
githubReviewBots.aria: Toggle GitHub review bots experimental setting

grokBot.title: Grok Bot
grokBot.description: Connect an existing Grok Bot as an agent. Verify routine delivery and an authenticated reply before assigning work.
grokBot.footnote: Requires Assistant connections (MCP), Paperclip Runner, and authenticated public HTTPS. Usage is not reported. Turning this off blocks Grok calls and new dispatch.

memoryConnectors.title: Memory connectors
memoryConnectors.description: Connect Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Cognee, and Honcho for long-term memory and context.
memoryConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides setup for these connectors. Existing connections keep running.

muse.title: Muse — Personal agent
muse.description: Connect your personal Meta Muse. Pair it, detect its receiver, and verify an independent background reply before assigning tasks.
muse.footnote: Requires Paperclip Runner and an authenticated instance with a public HTTPS URL. Turning this off blocks new work; cleanup and stop evidence remain available. Provider usage and cost are unavailable.

openAiDot.title: OpenAI Dot
openAiDot.description: Add OpenAI Dot as a standalone agent choice. Pair your Dot and verify event delivery before assigning work.
openAiDot.footnote: Requires Assistant connections (MCP) and an authenticated instance with a public HTTPS URL. Turning this off blocks Dot calls and new work; saved connections are kept.

paperclipRunner.title: Paperclip Runner
paperclipRunner.description: Allow agents to select Paperclip Runner, including authenticated runner ingress when a sandbox requires it. First-run setup offers qualified GitHub Copilot. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.

simplifiedEnglish.title: Simplified English Interactions
simplifiedEnglish.description: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
simplifiedEnglish.aria: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting

statusCards.title: Status Cards
statusCards.description: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
statusCards.footnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.

streamlinedUi.title: Streamlined UI
streamlinedUi.description: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
streamlinedUi.footnote: Turning this off restores the legacy shell and navigation. Task and page data are unchanged.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
summaries.footnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.

isolatedByDefault.title: Use Isolated Workspaces By Default
isolatedByDefault.description: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
isolatedByDefault.aria: Toggle isolated workspaces by default experimental setting

autoRestart.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestart.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

managedEnvOnly.title: Managed Environment Only
managedEnvOnly.description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
managedEnvOnly.aria: Toggle managed environment only experimental setting

developerMode.title: Paperclip Developer Mode
developerMode.description: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
developerMode.aria: Toggle Paperclip developer mode experimental setting

worktreeRun.title: Run tasks in this worktree
worktreeRun.description: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
worktreeRun.suppressedMismatch: This setting was armed in a different instance and copied here, so no tasks run automatically.
worktreeRun.suppressedMissingCutoff: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.
worktreeRun.suppressedSuffix: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.

serverInfoDebug.title: Server Info Debug View
serverInfoDebug.description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
serverInfoDebug.aria: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting

smokeLab.title: Smoke Lab
smokeLab.description: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.

taskPlanDecomposition.title: Task Plan Decomposition
taskPlanDecomposition.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
taskPlanDecomposition.aria: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting

classicTaskInterface.title: Classic Task Interface
classicTaskInterface.description: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
classicTaskInterface.footnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
classicTaskInterface.aria: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting

goalsSidebarLink.title: Goals Sidebar Link
goalsSidebarLink.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
goalsSidebarLink.aria: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting
